fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records carry headline/articleBody-style fields; latest-mode records (site RSS feed) carry title/link-style fields. Upstream HTML microdata is passed through close to verbatim, so extra fields beyond those listed here may also appear.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (e.g. S1-microdata+html, S2-rss).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind (e.g. not_found, unexpected_shape).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

dek.title: Dek
dek.description: Sub-headline / lede sentence shown under the headline (article mode only).

description.title: Description
description.description: Short article description/summary from meta tags (article mode).

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description: Full article text, reconstructed from paragraph tags with inline ad widgets stripped out (article mode).

author.title: Author
author.description: Byline -- observed as always institutional ("Gazeta" / "Gazeta.uz"), even on guest op-eds, never a personal name (both modes).

section.title: Section
section.description: Site section from the breadcrumb (e.g. "Economy", "Politics") (article mode only).

datePublished.title: Date published
datePublished.description: ISO 8601 publish date with UTC+5 offset (article mode only).

image.title: Image
image.description: Lead image URL, from og:image (article mode only).

pubDate.title: Publish date
pubDate.description: RFC 822 publish timestamp as given by the feed (latest mode).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
